help:
NeoHaskell native installer

This build checks the official Nix 2.34.9 Linux ARM64 daemon. Other providers and platforms remain unverified. New acquisition is blocked until configuration ownership is established. Local checks for retained keep and rollback remain available. This build does not install, configure, or repair Nix.

Usage:
  neo-installer [--help | --version]
  neo-installer install [--version VERSION]
  neo-installer update [--version VERSION | --rollback]
  neo-installer rollback

Install keeps an existing installation unless an exact version is requested. Update selects a complete stable candidate. Update --rollback and rollback restore the recorded previous pair.
Use --yes to accept the prepared installation review.
invalid_arguments: Unknown arguments. Run neo-installer --help for usage.
invalid_request: Use install or update with an optional --version VERSION, update --rollback, or rollback without arguments.
operation_complete: NeoHaskell {version} is active. Both commands passed verification.
operation_failed: The lifecycle operation did not complete. Check the existing Nix 2.34.9 installation and the availability of a complete release candidate. Saved installation state will be reconciled on the next run.
previous_missing: The recorded previous version has a missing output.
previous_unchecked: The previous version is recorded without a current health check.
installed_lifecycle_help:
This build checks the official Nix 2.34.9 Linux ARM64 daemon. New acquisition is blocked until configuration ownership is established.
  neo update [--version VERSION | --rollback]  Update or restore the installed pair.
  neo rollback                                 Alias for neo update --rollback.

Retained rollback uses local checks. Other providers and platforms remain unverified. These operations do not install, configure, or repair Nix.
Use --yes to accept the prepared installation review.
nix_missing_client: The standard Nix client is missing. This build cannot establish a fresh or partial installation.
nix_unproved_client: The Nix client identity is not supported by this build. No replacement was attempted.
nix_unproved_platform: Nix service observation is not yet verified on this platform.
nix_inactive_service: The required Nix system service is not active.
nix_unproved_service: The loaded Nix service does not match the verified service configuration.
nix_daemon_unavailable: The standard Nix daemon is unavailable to this user.
nix_daemon_mismatch: The Nix daemon response does not match the verified client and service.
nix_configuration_owner_unknown: New acquisition is blocked because Nix configuration ownership and required daemon policy are not established. This build made no Nix configuration changes.
operation_stopped_no_pair: The operation stopped. No NeoHaskell pair is active.
operation_stopped_pair: The operation stopped. NeoHaskell {version} is active.
cleanup_unknown: The operation failed because process cleanup could not be confirmed. Saved resource work remains pending for recovery.
consent_required: Explicit consent is required. Run this command with --yes to accept its review.
review_declined: The reviewed operation was declined. No requested changes were admitted.
review_changed: The reviewed installation changed. No requested changes were admitted. Run the command again to review its current state.
recovery_unadmitted: Earlier recovery may still be pending. It was not changed by this request.
review_command_directory: Create the owned command directory if required.
review_command_links: Maintain the owned Neo and neoctl command links.
review_selection: Save the selected version and its metadata.
review_activation: Activate the selected package pair if it differs.
